requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
requirement.note: Sale/licensing ban, landlord-use ban, tenant remedies, and fee-shifting all appear in §§98.1102-98.1104. The card says a tenant 'wins' for fees; the text also gives fees to a prevailing landlord, which is a minor omission.

key_value.evidence: For each month a violation of section 98.1103(b) exists or continues, and for each residential rental property a landlord uses an algorithmic device, it shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
key_value.note: The $1,000 cap per violation is in §98.1104(a). The separate-violation rule applies to landlord use under 98.1103(b).

effective_date.evidence: (“Purpose and Intent” added 5-22-2025 by O-21955 N.S.; effective 6-21-2025.)

status.evidence: (“Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing” added 5-22-2025 by O-21955 N.S.; effective 6-21-2025.)
status.note: The document presents the adopted text as current law with no repeal or sunset, so in_force as of 2026-10-01 is consistent.

citation.evidence: §98.1103 Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
citation.note: The cited sections 98.1102, 98.1103, and 98.1104 and ordinance O-21955 N.S. all appear in the document.
